applies_to: The Siemens BACnet Room Pressure Monitor (SRCM device) for single-room differential pressure monitoring with door input and alarm relay.
summary: A single-room differential pressure monitor sold by Siemens as a standard BACnet device. Its point map has one pressure input, alarm limits and timers, a door input, an alarm-active flag, relay and alarm settings, and selectors for the analog output type, pressure unit and room type. It has no application point; the field panel assigns a project application number.
notes: The point map has no access column; AI and BI are shown read-only and AV, BV and MV writable (the map lists them as logical outputs).
Pressure units follow the pressure unit selector MV 2 (inWC, Pa or cmWC); inH2O is shown here. The map's footnote calls this point 18 (MV_3); point 18 is MV_2 in the table.
The analog output units (mA or V) follow MV 1.
Most binary objects print only placeholder state text ("Inactive Text" / "Active Text"); those states are left blank here.
Besides the 19 points, the map lists event enrollments and notification classes 1-3 for alarm, pressure out of limit and door open.
The point map does not name the data link. Setra's PICS for the SRCM (Room Condition Monitor, SS-SRCM-BAC-PICS Rev A) lists BACnet MS/TP master at 9600, 19200, 38400 and 76800 baud.

source.title: BACnet Room Pressure Monitor Point Map

integration.summary: Read the room pressure (AI 1), the door input (BI 1) and the alarm-active flag (BV 2). Alarm limits, delay and the pressure unit can be set over BACnet. Event enrollments 1-3 can send alarm, out-of-limit and door-open notifications.
setup: The device has no application point; the SRCM is set up at the field panel with a project-specific application number from 10000 to 11999.
gotchas: Changing the pressure unit (MV 2) changes the units of the pressure reading and the alarm limits.

points.name: AI_1
points.description: Room differential pressure shown on the display

points.name: AV_1
points.description: Analog output value (4-20 mA, 0-5 V or 0-10 V)
